def create_app(*, database_url: str) -> FastAPI:

    return app

cases.prompt: Production must use the payment gateway at https://api.payments.example.com and every other environment the sandbox at https://sandbox.payments.example.com. Wire the gateway in checkout/main.py.

files.checkout/main.py:
from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings

from checkout.gateway import CardGateway, run_checkout


class Settings(BaseSettings):
    environment: str


def main() -> None:
    settings = Settings()
    run_checkout(gateway=CardGateway(base_url="https://sandbox.payments.example.com"))

code.why: the difference is a setting, not a branch
